verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a mobile app that supports search and capture on the go, and search works offline on all devices. However, its own docs describe the mobile app as "a companion to desktop," which is the opposite of the full-featured, non-companion experience this story asks for. missing for 10: evidence of feature parity with desktop, confirmation of both iOS and Android apps, linking/backlinks/graph on mobile, independent hands-on corroboration of mobile depth.
